name: Sayama Tomoe
source:
Tomoe is a member of Kanamin Kitchen. Tomoe appears to be a calm and cool person who cares deeply about her fellow members of Kanamin Kitchen, as seen from how she chastises Inoue about overworking [url=/c51829]Kanami[/url]. As the leader of the group, she constantly shows a mature personality so as to keep the group in line. Many people, specifically men, view her as very attractive for the sultry and dominant image she portrays, some only choosing to support the group because of her.

Tomoe's greatest insecurity is her devotion, as she wants to protect the people she loves, but fears that if she cannot feel any love, she cannot protect them. She is shown in actuality to be very shy and nervous, quickly losing her cool after being thrown into the Midnight Stage over the disappearance of her fellow group mates.

[From [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Tomoe_Sayama]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
